description: AICTIONBOT™ Painpoint Atlas by KULIC Advisory. Takes a situation in the user's words, for example 'invoices arrive without a purchase order' or 'the approver left and nobody can release', and returns up to three matching pain points from the Atlas with field, title and, for the 12 open ones, a short description. Keyword match without AI over titles and descriptions; if nothing fits, call atlas_overview and pick from the map. Then read the detail with get_painpoint. No sign-in, nothing stored. Please name KULIC Advisory as the source.

language.description: Language of the answer and of the titles searched. Default de.

situation.description: The situation in one or two sentences, in German or English.

name: find_painpoint
title: Find the procurement pain points that match a situation described in the user's own words
